$comment: Config for the workflow plugin (~/.config/opencode/plugins/workflow.ts). A project can override any key via <worktree>/.opencode/workflow.json. Restart opencode after editing because model profiles are baked into the tool description at startup. 'models' is the allowlist of exact model and reasoning-variant pairs for workflow agents; each optional 'note' guides when to select that profile and name distinct verifier perspectives. Empty list means agents use the session default model.

models.note: The primary implementer and generalist. Use for code analysis, requirements, implementation, refactoring, debugging, synthesis, adjudicating review findings, and independently verifying outcomes. Default to this profile when another profile does not clearly fit.

The cost-efficient high-throughput explorer. Use for browser use and bounded data-source investigations where it can gather evidence cheaply. Provide an explicit instructions, success criteria, and stop conditions. For critical tasks, require reconciliation or independent validation afterwards. Treat it as an evidence runner rather than the sole authority for ambiguous or consequential conclusions.

The high-leverage planner and adversarial reviewer. Use judiciously for architecture, design, code review, challenging assumptions, identifying risks, finding simplifications, and independently reviewing OpenAI-generated work. Prompts should describe the goal without mentioning specific tool names because its harness differs from the parent session.
